ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Arbitrary DLL Load Using Winword
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential DLL sideloading using the Microsoft Office winword process via the '/l' flag.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\WINWORD\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "WinWord\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/l\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.dll.*")))
